message.content:
Based on my search, here's how to log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**:

## Official Login Page

Go to the official Government of Canada MSCA portal:
**https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html**

## Sign-In Options

You have **three ways** to sign in:

| Method | What You Need |
|--------|---------------|
| **GCKey** | A Government of Canada username and password (works across multiple government services) |
| **Sign-In Partner** | Your existing online banking credentials from participating banks (RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, Desjardins, etc.) |
| **Provincial Digital ID** | Available if you live in **Alberta** or **British Columbia** |

## Step-by-Step Login Process

1. Visit the official MSCA login page
2. Click on your preferred sign-in method (GCKey, Sign-In Partner, or Provincial ID)
3. Enter your credentials
4. Complete any identity validation steps if prompted (this may be required periodically for security)

## What You Can Access in MSCA

- Employment Insurance (EI) claims and reports
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP) benefits and contribution history
- Old Age Security (OAS) and Guaranteed Income Supplement (GIS)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) information
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A(P), T4A(OAS))
- Direct deposit and personal information updates
- Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
- National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) account

## Important Notes

- **GCKey and CRA login are separate** — you cannot use GCKey to access Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) services
- If you forgot your GCKey password, use the "Forgot your password" link on the GCKey Welcome screen
- Supported browsers: Chrome 84+, Safari 13.1.2+, Edge 85+, Firefox 68+
- Clear your browser cache or use incognito mode if you experience login issues

## Need Help?

- **Service Canada**: 1-800-O-Canada (1-800-622-6232)
- **Interac support** (for Sign-In Partner issues): 1-855-433-5397
